notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-11-02, b4576 — the clipboard after a used copy and the card that was silent, notarized): The clipboard rule after a copy you have used, and the card for a paste that landed somewhere else. (1) A used copy retires at the next dictation. A manually copied item stays on the clipboard across dictations until you use it; after that one use the next dictation's own text takes the clipboard, so your next ⌘V pastes the dictation. A copy you never use still survives five dictations. (2) A hand paste right after a dictation shows the card. If you paste by hand within four seconds of a dictation's own paste, the app now shows the gentle recovery card with the transcript instead of only noting the anomaly, and the transcript is placed back on the clipboard. (3) Your own ⌘C is always yours. A ⌘C you press yourself within four seconds of a clipboard change marks that copy as yours even when its text equals the last dictation.
